documents.name: Oceanário de Lisboa
documents.summary: Oceanário de Lisboa is a aquarium destination in Lisbon, retained for distinctive visitor-experience quality.
documents.whyWorthwhile: A landmark central-ocean aquarium whose spatial design and ecosystem presentation remain destination-worthy.

audience.notes: Editorial destination-fit profile derived from the researched positive age span. Bands without positive evidence remain unknown rather than being treated as a positive match or a hard prohibition. Individual rides and activities may have stricter operator rules.

documents.name: Portuguese School of Equestrian Art — Full Gala
documents.localName: Escola Portuguesa de Arte Equestre — Gala
documents.summary: A formal Portuguese haute-école gala with Alter Real Lusitano horses, period costume, music and historic court exercises.
documents.whyWorthwhile: A rare, polished way to experience Portuguese court equestrian tradition as a complete live performance.

booking.note: Book a listing explicitly described as a full gala.

coreExperience.note: Horsemanship is visual; programme and voice-over add context.

mobility.note: Some seating sectors have access limitations.

full-gala-only.label: Choose a full gala
full-gala-only.note: Morning training/presentation sessions are a different, smaller experience.

documents.name: World of Discoveries
documents.summary: World of Discoveries is a interactive history destination in Porto, retained for distinctive visitor-experience quality.
documents.whyWorthwhile: A compact but distinctive ride-and-walkthrough interpretation of Portuguese exploration, stronger as family storytelling than as a conventional museum.
